entities.name: Okinec Ahau
entities.description: Sovereign of the Malamet on Ixalan, called the Deep King and worshipped as the only god among his people.

entities.name: Malamet
entities.description: People of Ixalan's caverns ruled by Okinec Ahau.

entities.name: Ban Koj
entities.description: Cavern site where Okinec sits in a pyramid.

entities.name: Vito
entities.description: Heretic leading the Queen's Bay Company expedition.

entities.name: Amalia
entities.description: Vampire cartomancer who created an escape from the sand pit.

entities.name: Queen's Bay Company
entities.description: Surface company that sent an expedition into the caverns.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which the caverns beneath Ixalan opened.

events.summary: Kutzil brings the vampire expedition before Okinec's throne; Vito accidentally insults him by implying other gods exist.
events.quote: The Vampires were brought before Okinec's throne by Kutzil

events.summary: Okinec decrees the vampires be thrown into quicksand, but Amalia creates an escape.
events.quote: their cartomancer Amalia created an escape from the sand pit

relations.quote: He is the sovereign of the Malamet
